_readme: Ship-module engineering blueprints for the Commander view's Engineering list (outrider/commander.py): one row per kind of module and blueprint, the materials each grade takes (by the journal's material names) and the engineers offering it for that kind. Built by scripts/build_blueprints.py from EDCD's coriolis-data (https://github.com/EDCD/coriolis-data, commit 0db9234b5b9ce8c939ea84133d7ce336eea88e27 of 2026-04-24: modifications/blueprints.json, modifications/modules.json); coriolis-data's LICENSE.md: the data and its JSON files are the intellectual property and copyright of Frontier Developments plc and subject to its terms and conditions (https://www.frontierstore.net/terms-and-conditions/); only coriolis.io's own code is MIT. Experimental effects and Odyssey suit and weapon upgrades are not in it.
